Delete Ec Route By Vm
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:ecgroupId/vm/:vmId/route

Deletes a specific Cloud or Branch Connector route associated with a VM in the group.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ecgroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector group ID.

vmId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.
